query: What aspects of their experience are Yelp reviewers talking about?

per_column.name: food_quality
per_column.rationale: A core aspect axis directly answering the query; well-distributed. Grounded in most rows, but YLP-0005 (drinks/entry only, no food mentioned) is flagged 1, an over-assertion.

per_column.name: service
per_column.rationale: Distinct, high-value aspect flag. Values align well with source text across samples.

per_column.name: ambiance
per_column.rationale: Meaningful aspect axis; sampled 0-values are reasonable readings where ambiance is unmentioned.

per_column.name: value
per_column.rationale: Useful pricing/value axis; grounded (e.g. YLP-0003 pricing discussion flagged 1).

per_column.name: location
per_column.rationale: Legitimate aspect; skewed but not near-constant. Sampled values are sound.

per_column.name: cleanliness
per_column.rationale: Valid aspect but heavily skewed (225/25), giving limited grouping leverage; sampled 0s are correct silent readings.

per_column.name: wait_time
per_column.rationale: Useful aspect; YLP-0002 flagged 1 is a warranted inference (repeated forgetting/delays), though borderline.

per_column.name: menu_variety
per_column.rationale: Reasonable aspect axis; sampled 0s consistent with source. Somewhat skewed.

per_column.name: primary_aspect
per_column.rationale: Free-text dominant-aspect summary is directly on-query and complements the binary flags. Sampled values fairly summarize the text, though granularity produces a long fragmented tail.

judge.rationale: The added columns decompose the reviews into named experiential aspects (food, service, ambiance, value, location, cleanliness, wait time, menu variety) plus a free-text primary_aspect, which is exactly the group/compare leverage the query 'what aspects are reviewers talking about?' needs. Each binary column is a distinct axis and none is near-constant or a pure restatement. Values are generally sound readings of the source text, with reasonable silent-row zeros. The main groundedness weakness is occasional over-assertion (e.g. food_quality=1 for the cabana/drinks review YLP-0005 where no food is discussed). Overall a strong, on-target augmentation.
